svg.title: Drilling operator — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as drilling operator, wearing coveralls and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A long spiral drill descends from a compact drill head into a separated ground line. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat and round glasses.
